name: Economy Class Policy
description: All flights must be booked in economy class unless the journey exceeds 8 hours.
rules: Economy class is standard for all routes under 8 hours
Business class requires manager approval for routes over 8 hours
Booking must be made at least 7 days in advance when possible
Refundable tickets preferred when price difference is under $50

name: Hotel Policy
description: Hotels must be rated 3-4 stars. 5-star requires executive approval.
rules: Hotel must be within 5 km of primary destination or attraction cluster
Breakfast inclusion preferred when available at no extra cost

name: Daily Expense Policy
description: Per diem limits for meals and incidentals by region.
rules: Receipts required for all expenses over $25

name: Cancellation Policy
description: Cancellation and refund rules for all travel bookings.
rules: Cancel flights 72+ hours before departure for full refund
Travel insurance mandatory for trips over $2000
